title: German Buckwheat Crumble
description: A twist on traditional German desserts, this buckwheat crumble combines the nutty flavor of buckwheat with a crunchy citrusy topping.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the buckwheat and reconstituted cranberries.
In a separate bowl, mix the almond flour, honey, coconut oil, and salt.
Add the crumb mixture to the buckwheat mixture and mix until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with an additional layer of the crumb mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.
Allow to cool for 10 minutes before serving.
